title_en: Fan Bingzhang, Ye Yirong, et al. — case of hooliganism, intentional injury, theft, and escape
keywords_en: criminal; hooliganism; intentional injury; theft; escape from custody; second instance; High People's Court; Fujian Province; natural person; criminal law; whether constituting hooliganism; whether constituting intentional injury; whether constituting theft; whether constituting escape from custody; determination of principal and accessory; partial support; affray; creating disturbances; causing injury with a firearm; theft of motorcycle; escape; intentional injury; theft
full_text_en:
Fan Bingzhang, Ye Yirong, et al. — case concerning hooliganism, intentional injury, theft, and escape

Appellant (original defendant): Fan Bingzhang, male, born February 7, 1972, Han ethnicity, native of Songxi County, Fujian Province, unemployed, residing at No. 10 Huancheng Road, Songyuan Town, Songxi County. Arrested on September 29, 1994.

Appellant (original defendant): Ye Yirong, male, born May 2, 1964, Han ethnicity, native of Songxi County, Fujian Province, farmer, residing at No. 106 Mingde Road, Songyuan Town, Songxi County. Previously subjected to re-education through labor for three years for theft; sentenced to 11 months' imprisonment for intentional injury on February 4, 1994; arrested on September 29, 1994.

Original defendant: Liu Zeping, male, born July 7, 1968, Han ethnicity, native of Songxi County, Fujian Province, farmer, residing at No. 32 Gongnong West Road, Songyuan Town, Songxi County. In December 1987, subjected to three years of re-education through labor for pickpocketing; during that period, sentenced to an additional one year and three months for escape. Arrested on August 24, 1994.

Original defendant: Wu Shisong, male, born May 2, 1971, Han ethnicity, native of Songxi County, Fujian Province, unemployed, residing at No. 15 Shuinan Street, Songxi County. Arrested on September 22, 1994.

Original defendant: Pan Wanxi, male, born April 11, 1977, Han ethnicity, native of Songxi County, Fujian Province, farmer, residing at No. 124 Nan Street, Songxi County. Arrested on September 26, 1994.

Original defendant: Ye Xingyong, male, born February 4, 1977, Han ethnicity, native of Songxi County, Fujian Province, worker at Fuzhou Yishan Wood Carving Factory, residing at No. 4 Zhucuo Lane, Songxi County Town. Arrested on September 26, 1994.

Defendants Fan Bingzhang and Ye Yirong, dissatisfied with the criminal judgment (1995) Nan Xing Chu Zi No. 51 of the Nanping Intermediate People's Court of Fujian Province, appealed to the Fujian High People's Court.

The original judgment found that on April 12, 1993, Defendant Fan Bingzhang decided to retaliate against Qiu Zhaohui, who was hospitalized, because Defendant Pan Wanxi had previously engaged in mutual assault with Qiu Zhaohui and others. That evening, Fan Bingzhang, Pan Wanxi, Defendant Ye Xingyong, and others, including Zou Tuanjie, Kang Zengzhong, Xia Keliang, and Ye Zhangjian (all separately prosecuted), went to the hospital. On the way, Fan directed his accomplices to assault Huang Zhenwang, with whom he had a conflict, but failed; Fan personally slashed Huang on the right side of his head with a knife, causing a scalp defect constituting a minor injury. At the hospital entrance, Fan Bingzhang used an iron bar to unjustifiably beat Zhang Xiangqing, a friend of Qiu Zhaohui, and Ye Xingyong also joined in with punches and kicks. Then, Fan Bingzhang ordered his accomplices to enter the hospital and beat Qiu. Pan Wanxi kicked open the ward door and swung an axe at Qiu Zhaohui, who was lying in bed; Qiu escaped from the room. Fan Bingzhang kicked Qiu once and chased him with a martial arts sword, forcing Qiu to flee.

Around noon on May 8, 1993, Defendant Fan Bingzhang, to seek revenge, along with Ye Zhangjian, chased Ye Zhangming with a martial arts sword on the main street near the County Grain Bureau. Fan slashed Ye Zhangming once on the head and once on the hand, causing a minor injury. On an evening in the same month, upon learning that his accomplices were engaged in mutual assault with Xiong Wei and others, Fan Bingzhang carried a hunting rifle to the vicinity of the County Gymnasium and fired at Xiong Wei and others on the main street, missing them.

At approximately 7:00 p.m. on June 21, 1992, Defendant Fan Bingzhang, to seek revenge, used a double-barreled hunting rifle at the "July 1" Bridge in the county town to shoot at Wang Huiping, who was walking on the main street, hitting Wang's left elbow and causing a serious injury. At approximately 10:00 p.m. on June 30 of the same year, due to a previous conflict with Xu Chun from mutual assault, Fan Bingzhang drove a three-wheeled motorcycle carrying Li Xin (at large), who was holding a hunting rifle, and charged toward Xu Chun, Chen Jianhua, and others. Fan ordered Li Xin to shoot at Xu Chun, hitting Chen Jianhua in the abdomen and right thigh, causing a minor injury, while Xu Chun fled. On July 19 of the same year, Fan Bingzhang was taken into custody for investigation. At approximately 4:00 p.m. on August 2, he took advantage of the exercise period to rush out of the cell door, scaling the wall to escape.

On the evening of January 1, 1994, Defendant Fan Bingzhang, along with Li Xin, Wang Qiuhua, and Xu Tianzhi (all at large), formed a group to help others in a fight. They encountered Ye Hui, who was coming to assist the opposing side. Fan Bingzhang and the other four used wooden sticks to strike Ye Hui's mandible, causing a fracture, significantly altering Ye's facial appearance and resulting in a serious injury. At approximately 8:00 p.m. on January 7 of the same month, Fan Bingzhang, Xu Tianzhi, Pan Xiangsheng, and others went to a barbershop run by a person surnamed Zhou in Hecun, Jiangshan City, Zhejiang Province, to cause trouble, unjustifiably beating Zhang Jianhua. Xu Tianzhi used scissors to sever Zhang Jianhua's left superficial temporal artery, causing a minor injury. At approximately 7:00 p.m. on January 9 of the same month, Fan Bingzhang, hired by Ye Yunsheng, along with Xu Tianzhi and others, armed with weapons and masked, kicked the door of Huang Liping's home—a female cadre of the County Forestry Committee—intending to assault her, but the plan was foiled because Huang called for help. That same night, when they changed their route and passed by Zhang Shengfu's home, Fan was bitten by Zhang's wolfdog. The next day, Fan and his accomplices found Zhang Shengfu and beat him, forcing Zhang to pay RMB 1,000. Afterwards, Fan Bingzhang demanded RMB 2,500 from Ye Yunsheng; Xu Tianzhi and Wang Qiuhua each received RMB 200.

Late one night in March 1994, Defendant Fan Bingzhang, to seek revenge, along with Wang Qiuhua and Xu Tianzhi, went to the barbershop run by Zheng Xiaohong to cause trouble. Fan kicked and broke the glass door and beat Zheng Xiaohong and a shop assistant named You. On the evening of March 27 of that month, Fan Bingzhang asked Ye Wu at a night stall to borrow a hunting rifle; Ye refused. Fan, along with Li Xin and Wang Qiuhua, grabbed Ye Wu on the main street, holding him, and forcibly took the hunting rifle.

Defendants Fan Bingzhang and Wu Shisong also, on an evening in August 1992, broke into the home of Cai Xiguang, an individual wholesaler. Wu Shisong inserted a dagger he had brought onto Cai's table. Fan picked up Cai's kitchen knife and chopped a square stool, threatening Cai Xiguang to come out, and demanded to forcibly contract the chicken feet wholesale business that Cai was operating.

On April 12, 1994, Defendant Fan Bingzhang, along with Hu Zhehai and Nie Jianlong (both separately prosecuted), stole another person's Suzuki King 125 motorcycle on Yangqiao Road in Fuzhou, selling it to a person surnamed Hao for RMB 6,400. Fan Bingzhang received RMB 2,000.

After helping a person surnamed Yan recover part of the cash extorted by a person surnamed Luo in February 1994, Defendant Liu Zeping proposed to Fan Bingzhang that they recover the remaining amount for themselves. Subsequently, Fan, Liu, along with Xu Tianzhi, Wang Qiuhua, Pan Xiangsheng, and others, broke into Luo's home demanding money and beating him. Forced into a corner, Luo handed over RMB 5,000 to Liu Zeping, who split the illicit gains equally with Fan Bingzhang.

On the morning of February 25, 1994, after unjustifiably beating Pei Xinhua on the street, Defendant Ye Yirong, along with Defendants Fan Bingzhang and Wu Shisong later that same day, holding folding knives, extorted RMB 8,000 from Pei on the pretext that Pei had informed the public security authorities. Fan and Ye each received RMB 3,000, and Wu Shisong received RMB 2,000. Ye Yirong and Wu Shisong also, in March and April 1994, along with others, monopolized the purchase of spring bamboo shoots in the Gaoyang Village area of Chaping Township, Songxi County, engaging in forced buying and selling.

Defendants Fan Bingzhang, Ye Yirong, Liu Zeping, Wu Shisong, Pan Wanxi, and Ye Xingyong openly defied the law, engaged in affrays, created disturbances, and extorted money, with despicable circumstances, all constituting the crime of hooliganism. Fan Bingzhang, by using firearms and clubs to intentionally injure others, causing serious injury, constituted the crime of intentional injury. After being taken into custody and detained, he escaped from the detention facility, subsequently continued to commit crimes in the Songxi County urban area, and secretly stole another person's property in a huge amount, constituting the crimes of escape and theft respectively. Fan Bingzhang committed 13 criminal acts, acting as the principal in 7 of the joint crimes; he was a principal offender, causing serious injury to 2 victims and minor injury to 3 victims. His criminal arrogance was rampant, causing extremely bad influence and particularly serious harm. Defendant Ye Yirong also played a major role in the joint crimes, being a principal offender and a recidivist. Liu Zeping should be given a heavier punishment because he committed crimes again within three years after being released from re-education through labor. Defendants Wu Shisong, Pan Wanxi, and Ye Xingyong were accessories in the joint crimes. Pan Wanxi and Ye Xingyong were under 18 years old when committing the crimes, so they may be given a lighter punishment.

Accordingly, the court of first instance rendered judgment according to law: Defendant Fan Bingzhang was convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; convicted of intentional injury and sentenced to ten years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for one year; convicted of theft and sentenced to six years' imprisonment; convicted of escape and sentenced to two years' imprisonment; the combined sentence was death, with deprivation of political rights for life. Defendant Ye Yirong was convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to seven years' imprisonment. Defendant Liu Zeping was convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to four years' imprisonment. Defendant Wu Shisong was convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to three years' imprisonment. Defendant Pan Wanxi was convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to one year's imprisonment, suspended for two years. Defendant Ye Xingyong was convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to one year's imprisonment, suspended for two years.

After the judgment of the court of first instance was pronounced, Appellant Fan Bingzhang appealed, claiming that he did not instruct Li Xin to shoot at Xu Chun; that he did not participate in beating Ye Hui to the ground; that he did not play a major role in the joint crimes, and requested a lighter punishment. Appellant Ye Yirong appealed, claiming that borrowing money from Pei Xinhua should not be considered a crime, and requested a lighter punishment.

The Fujian High People's Court, upon trial, ascertained:

Appellant Fan Bingzhang had a conflict with Xu Chun due to mutual assault. At approximately 10:00 p.m. on June 20, 1993, Fan Bingzhang was driving a three-wheeled motorcycle carrying Li Xin, who was holding a hunting rifle, near the County Cultural Center in the county town when they encountered Xu Chun, Chen Jianhua, and two others. Fan Bingzhang turned the vehicle and charged toward Xu Chun and the others. Li Xin and Xu Chun exchanged gunfire, and Chen Jianhua was hit by Li Xin's shot. According to forensic medical evaluation, Chen Jianhua sustained minor injuries from the hunting rifle shot to the abdominal wall and deep soft tissue (muscle layer) of the right thigh, with retained metallic fragments.

At approximately 9:00 p.m. on January 1, 1994, upon learning that his accomplice Pan Xiangsheng was engaged in mutual assault with Yang Rongchang, Appellant Fan Bingzhang, along with Li Xin, Wang Qiuhua, and Xu Tianzhi, rushed to help in the fight. When they reached the "July 1" Bridge in the county town, they encountered Ye Hui, who was coming to assist the opposing side. Fan, Xu, Wang, and Li picked up wooden sticks nearby and jointly beat Ye Hui to the ground, causing a fracture of Ye's left mandible, affecting his facial appearance. After a new forensic evaluation, it was determined to be a minor injury.

Between January and March 1994, Appellant Fan Bingzhang, along with Xu Tianzhi, Wang Qiuhua, and others, twice went to Zheng Xiaohong's "Lumei" barbershop in the middle of the night, demanding that the shop assistant open the door to wash their hair. When the assistant refused, Fan Bingzhang, Xu Tianzhi, and others used stones and bricks to smash the glass door and glass coffee table, and also beat Zheng Xiaohong and the shop assistant, a person surnamed You.

At approximately 9:00 p.m. on March 27, 1994, Appellant Fan Bingzhang asked Ye Wu at a night stall to borrow a hunting rifle, but was refused. After Ye left, Fan, along with Li Xin and Wang Qiuhua, caught up with Ye, held him on the main street, and forcibly took the hunting rifle. Afterwards, Fan wanted to pay RMB 1,000 to buy it from Ye, but Ye disagreed. The next day, Fan told Wang Qiuhua and Xu Tianzhi to force RMB 1,000 on Ye and then left.

Apart from the above five incidents, the remaining criminal facts of Appellant Fan Bingzhang as determined in the original judgment, as well as the hooliganism criminal facts of Appellant Ye Yirong and the original defendants Liu Zeping, Wu Shisong, Pan Wanxi, and Ye Xingyong, are clear, with sufficient evidence, including victim statements, testimonies from eyewitnesses, forensic medical evaluations, and relevant documentary evidence. Each defendant also confessed, which is sufficient for confirmation.

The Fujian High People's Court held that Appellants Fan Bingzhang and Ye Yirong, and original defendants Liu Zeping, Wu Shisong, Pan Wanxi, and Ye Xingyong, by gathering crowds to fight in public places, creating disturbances, forcing transactions, and extorting money, endangered public security with despicable circumstances. The acts of the six persons violated Article 160, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law of the PRC and constituted the crime of hooliganism, and each should be punished according to law. Fan Bingzhang, seeking revenge, intentionally injured others, causing serious injury to one person and minor injury to four persons. His acts constituted the crime of intentional injury as provided in Article 134, Paragraph 2 of the Criminal Law; together with others, by secret means, he stole another person's motorcycle, of a huge amount, constituting the crime of theft as provided in Article 152 of the Criminal Law; during lawful detention, he forcibly escaped, constituting the crime of escape as provided in Article 161, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law. Fan Bingzhang committed multiple crimes, and in accordance with Article 64 of the Criminal Law, should be subject to combined punishment for multiple crimes. Appellant Fan Bingzhang committed a total of 16 hooliganism acts, including 11 involving firearms or knives, illegally obtained RMB 14,000 of others' money through hooligan means, receiving RMB 6,500 in illicit gains. He acted as the leader or played a major role in 10 of the joint hooliganism crimes. In accordance with Article 23 of the Criminal Law, he was the principal offender in this case. His criminal arrogance was rampant, and the harm was particularly serious. In accordance with Item 1, Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Endanger Public Security, he should be severely punished, and in accordance with Article 53, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, his political rights should be deprived for life.

Appellant Ye Yirong, after release from imprisonment, committed crimes again, participating in two hooliganism incidents with despicable circumstances. He was a principal offender in the crimes and was a recidivist. In accordance with Article 23, Paragraph 1 and Article 61, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, he should be given a heavier punishment. Original defendant Liu Zeping committed one hooliganism crime with despicable circumstances within three years after being released from re-education through labor, and was also a principal offender in the crime. In accordance with Article 23, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law and Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Handling of Reform-through-Labor Offenders and Re-education-through-Labor Personnel Who Escape or Commit New Crimes, he should be given a heavier punishment.

Original defendant Wu Shisong committed three hooliganism acts, Pan Wanxi committed three, and Ye Xingyong committed two, all being accessories in the joint crimes. In accordance with Article 24 of the Criminal Law, they should be given a lighter punishment compared to the principal offenders. Pan Wanxi and Ye Xingyong were under 18 years old when committing the crimes. In accordance with Article 14, Paragraph 3 of the Criminal Law, they should be given a lighter punishment. In accordance with Article 67, Paragraph 1 of the Criminal Law, a suspended sentence may be applied to them.

The original judgment's finding that Appellant Fan Bingzhang instructed Li Xin to shoot at Xu Chun is insufficiently evidenced and is not confirmed. The finding that Fan Bingzhang beat Ye Hui causing serious injury is erroneous; after re-evaluation, it is determined to be minor injury. The calculation that he committed 13 hooliganism acts, being the principal in 7, causing serious injury to 2 and minor injury to 3, was incorrect. The application of Item 2, Article 1 of the Decision of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress Regarding the Severe Punishment of Criminals Who Seriously Endanger Public Security to his intentional injury crime was improper in terms of law application and sentencing and should be corrected. The remaining appeal grounds of Appellant Fan Bingzhang are inconsistent with the facts and are not adopted. Regarding Appellant Ye Yirong's claim that "borrowing money from Pei Xinhua should not be treated as a crime," upon investigation, Appellant Ye Yirong suspected that Pei Xinhua was responsible for his being summoned by the public security authorities. He then sought out Pei to create a disturbance, holding a folding knife, and extorted RMB 8,000 from Pei, which was divided among them. This act of creating disturbances and extorting others' money constitutes the crime of hooliganism. The appeal claim that it was "borrowing money" and should not be treated as a crime is not adopted.

In summary, the original judgment's characterization of each defendant's crimes of hooliganism, escape, and theft was accurate, the sentencing was appropriate, and the trial procedure was lawful. However, the application of law and sentencing for Defendant Fan Bingzhang's intentional injury crime were improper and should be corrected. Accordingly, in accordance with Items 1 and 2 of Article 136 of the Criminal Procedure Law of the PRC, the Fujian High People's Court rendered the following judgment on August 30, 1996:

1. Affirm Items 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 of the criminal judgment (1995) Nan Xing Chu Zi No. 51 of the Nanping Intermediate People's Court, i.e., the criminal judgments that Defendant Ye Yirong is convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to seven years' imprisonment; Defendant Liu Zeping is convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to four years' imprisonment; Defendant Wu Shisong is convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to three years' imprisonment; Defendant Pan Wanxi is convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to one year's imprisonment, suspended for two years; Defendant Ye Xingyong is convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to one year's imprisonment, suspended for two years.

2. Reverse the sentencing portion of Item 1 of the criminal judgment (1995) Nan Xing Chu Zi No. 51 of the Nanping Intermediate People's Court regarding "Defendant Fan Bingzhang is convicted of intentional injury and sentenced to ten years' imprisonment, with deprivation of political rights for one year."

3. Appellant Fan Bingzhang is convicted of hooliganism and sentenced to death, with deprivation of political rights for life; convicted of intentional injury and sentenced to six years' imprisonment; convicted of theft and sentenced to six years' imprisonment; convicted of escape and sentenced to two years' imprisonment. The combined sentence is death, with deprivation of political rights for life.

In accordance with the Notice of the Supreme People's Court Authorizing High People's Courts to Approve Certain Death Sentence Cases, the Fujian High People's Court approved the criminal judgment sentencing Appellant Fan Bingzhang to death for hooliganism, with deprivation of political rights for life; to six years' imprisonment for intentional injury; to six years' imprisonment for theft; and to two years' imprisonment for escape, with the combined sentence being death, with deprivation of political rights for life.
